name: Orison Synthform Loadout — Elongated Frame
description: Designed for synthetics with non-standard proportions — elongated limbs, narrow torsos, reversed-joint legs. A segmented bodysuit in smoke-grey adaptive mesh forms the base, with modular panel attachments that reconfigure via snap-tension rather than seams. Over it: a cropped asymmetric jacket with extended sleeve channels that accommodate limb length variance up to 40cm beyond human standard. Reversed-joint leg accommodation is built into the trouser via articulated gussets at the knee-analog joint. Footwear is a flat-soled wrap boot with adjustable tension strapping — no fixed heel. The silhouette is deliberately striking: this outfit doesn't pretend to be human-cut.
functionality: Snap-tension panels adjust to non-standard limb proportions without tailoring; articulated gussets accommodate reversed or multi-joint leg structures; extended sleeve channels for elongated arms; no fixed heel footwear for digitigrade or flat synthetic foot structures.
what_it_says: A synthetic who dresses for their own body, not an approximation of a human one.
worn_by: artists and performers with synthetic builds
story_hooks: Orison's founder disappeared during a Tier 5 corporate acquisition attempt — the label keeps running, no one knows who's making the decisions.
Wearing this in certain Tier 3 districts draws stares; wearing it in Tier 1 draws respect.
A specific colorway of this outfit is associated with a synthetic underground railroad moving artificial persons across corponation jurisdictions.

physical_description.visual_profile: A stark, angular silhouette designed explicitly for non-human synthetic frames. The elongated proportions create an uncanny elegance — narrow torso emphasized by the segmented bodysuit, limbs stretching into extended sleeve channels that disappear into the asymmetric jacket. The reversed-joint leg accommodation creates a distinctive knee articulation that breaks human biomechanics. Overall impression: deliberately alien, unapologetically synthetic, architecturally precise.
physical_description.fit: Compression-adaptive across the torso and limbs, with intentional slack in the sleeve channels to accommodate up to 40cm limb-length variance. The asymmetric jacket drapes with architectural precision rather than organic flow. Trouser gussets at knee-analog joints allow full articulation without bunching. Footwear wraps rather than encloses, using tension strapping instead of traditional heel structure.
physical_description.primary_material: Smoke-grey adaptive mesh (primary bodysuit base), likely a smart-responsive synthetic blend capable of minor shape accommodation. Modular panel attachments appear to be reinforced ballistic or technical weave. Jacket and trouser constructed from a stretchable, segmented material that moves independently at articulation points.
physical_description.texture: Smooth, uniform mesh surface with subtle geometric quilting that follows the segmentation lines. Panel attachments have a slightly stiffer, more technical finish. The material has a matte quality rather than reflective — designed for function over shine. Minimal drape; materials hold structural form.
physical_description.color_scheme: Dominant smoke-grey throughout the base layers, creating a cohesive, monochromatic foundation. Accent colors likely appear on modular panels and snap-tension attachment points — possibly neon accents (cyan, magenta) at articulation zones. No patterns; clean geometric divisions define the aesthetic.
physical_description.closures: Snap-tension modular system for panel attachments — allows on-the-fly reconfiguration. Extended sleeve channels likely use friction-fit or tension-lock mechanisms rather than traditional closures. Wrap boot secured via adjustable tension strapping with no fixed buckles.
distinctive_features: Segmented bodysuit base with geometric quilting that mirrors synthetic joint architecture
Extended sleeve channels with 40cm+ length accommodation
Modular snap-tension panel attachments for reconfiguration
Articulated gussets at knee-analog joint for reversed-leg accommodation
Asymmetric jacket cut that doesn't attempt human-standard proportions
Flat-soled wrap boot with tension strapping instead of traditional heel
Deliberately non-human silhouette — a statement of synthetic identity
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 4 functional, street-level aspirational. Manufactured by a synthetic-founded collective, not a corpo concern. Quality and design sophistication suggest above-basic street wear, but the deliberate rejection of human-standard proportions marks it as non-corpo.
physical_description.cultural_context: Worn by synthetics navigating the GLMZ who reject assimilationist fashion. This outfit announces: I am synthetic, my body is different, and I refuse to pretend otherwise. Often associated with synthetic activism, underground synthetic communities, and post-human identity movements. A statement piece in synthetic-majority spaces.
physical_description.condition_typical: Typically pristine or well-maintained; the modular system allows for easy panel replacement and repair without replacing the entire suit. Wear patterns would appear as subtle discoloration at snap-points and articulation zones from repeated reconfiguration.

The posture emphasizes impossible angles — reversed-joint legs, elongated proportions, architectural precision. Tension-strapped wrap boots ground the figure. Shot against a dark industrial backdrop with cool cyan and magenta accent lighting highlighting the modular snap-points and articulation gussets.
